rule: Real thisness at the actual roots
meaning: Population, whole-roster nontrapping, contingent dependence and excluded middle give an actual necessary root; unrestricted perfection, strict pure actuality and real thisness at the actual roots make it the only actual root. The whole-roster helper necessaryActualRoot supplies an actual root of the selected grounding relation at w that is necessary at accessible worlds. The pure-act theorem is applied through a re-indexing under which first-mover status is exactly actual rootness (firstIffRoot); the re-indexing asserts no motion or causation. Unlike NECESSARY-ROOT-UNIQUENESS, no maximum in being, grades, genus principle, has-being bridge or necessity-cause bridge is used. Necessary nonroots are not excluded, no God identification is made, and all premises stay OPEN.
